title_en: RetraQ: Manifold-Constrained Critic Guidance for Flow Policies in RL
title_zh: RetraQ：用于流策略的流形约束评论家引导
summary_en: RetraQ is a method that improves pretrained flow-matching policies by steering actions using a learned critic while constraining guidance to the data-supported manifold. It uses a single velocity evaluation of the frozen flow to define a denoising map, filters the critic gradient with the map's Jacobian, and applies the map to correct the updated action, approximating tangent filtering and retraction. The same update guides actions at test time and provides targets for policy distillation and online RL. In controlled studies, RetraQ improves true return while keeping actions close to the data region, and distillation targets are more stable than raw critic ascent. On LIBERO and OGBench offline-to-online training, RetraQ achieves higher mean final success than critic-guidance baselines; on a real-world plug-insertion task, test-time RetraQ improves success rate of a behavior-cloned π_{0.5} policy from 55.0% to 76.7%.
summary_zh: RetraQ 是一种通过学习的评论家引导改进预训练流匹配策略的方法，同时将引导约束在数据支持的流形上。它利用冻结流的一次速度评估定义去噪映射，用该映射的雅可比矩阵过滤评论家梯度，并应用映射本身校正更新后的动作，从而近似切空间过滤和回缩。相同的更新在测试时引导动作，并为策略蒸馏和在线强化学习提供目标。在控制实验中，RetraQ 提高了真实回报，同时使动作保持在数据支持区域附近，且蒸馏目标比原始评论家上升更稳定。在 LIBERO 和 OGBench 的离线到在线训练中，RetraQ 的平均最终成功率高于评估的评论家引导基线；在真实世界的插拔任务中，测试时的 RetraQ 将行为克隆的 π_{0.5} 策略的成功率从 55.0% 提高到 76.7%。
content_en: A learned critic can improve a pretrained flow-matching policy by steering sampled actions toward higher predicted value. However, even a critic that fits the behavior data well can provide misleading action gradients. Gradient components pointing away from the data-supported region are weakly constrained by behavior data and can lead guidance to exploit critic extrapolation errors. We introduce RetraQ (Retraction-based Q-guidance), which uses geometry encoded by the pretrained flow to constrain both the direction and the destination of critic guidance. A single velocity evaluation of the frozen flow defines a denoising map. RetraQ filters the critic gradient with the map's Jacobian and applies the map itself to correct the updated action. Our analysis characterizes when these operations approximate tangent filtering and retraction onto the behavior manifold. The same update guides actions at test time and provides targets for policy distillation and online reinforcement learning. In controlled studies, RetraQ improves true return while keeping refined actions close to the data-supported region, and its distillation targets remain more stable than those of raw critic ascent. In offline-to-online training on LIBERO and OGBench, RetraQ achieves higher mean final success than the evaluated critic-guidance baselines.
